info.title: sql-fun-server JSON-RPC api
info.description:
# `sql-fun` server api

`sql-fun` server provides database schema cache for `sql-fun` and schema aware
SQL semantics analysis.

oneOf.title: Domain base type not found : SF00001
oneOf.description:
Official Document: [CREATE DOMAIN statement](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-createdomain.html)

## Situation

```SQL
CREATE DOMAIN name AS base_type;
```

- `base_type` not found in schema semantic analysis context.

## Why

- Typo in `base_type`.
- `PostgreSQL` extension not enabled in context.
- When `base_type` defined in schema
  - Schema not specified.
  - Schema not in search path.

## Why

- When `function_name` defined in schema
  - Schema not specified.
  - Schema not in search path.

schema.description:
argument for `read_collection`

The item type returned by `read_collection` is identical to the element type
of the original `Collection<T>` that produced the handle, and never changes.
This method only reads the continuation of that collection; no type conversion
is performed.
